name: Prozen Integration for Dzen
author: fromgate

sections.description:
Prozen is a WordPress plugin that integrates your website with the Dzen blogging platform.

The plugin provides tools to:

  • export WordPress content to Dzen using a compatible RSS feed;
  • display Dzen publications on your website;
  • embed Dzen, VK Video, and RuTube videos using Gutenberg blocks.

Prozen is built for modern WordPress installations, supports the block editor, and uses a modular architecture.

Features

Dzen-Compatible RSS Feed

  • generates an RSS feed compatible with Dzen requirements;
  • removes unsupported markup automatically;
  • passes images in maximum available quality;
  • supports video players and media blocks;
  • supports Dzen-specific features such as anchor links and the video tag.

Gutenberg Blocks

  • Dzen Posts Grid – display recent Dzen publications in posts and pages;
  • Dzen Article Preview – insert a preview card linking to a Dzen article;
  • Video blocks for:
    • Dzen Video
    • VK Video
    • RuTube

Widgets

  • Dzen Channel Widget for displaying recent publications in widget areas.

Architecture

  • full Gutenberg support;
  • modular structure with optional modules;
  • minimal performance impact.

Prozen Plus & Plus Import

Prozen can be extended with the optional Prozen Plus plugin, which adds additional RSS options, visual customization and content management features.

Prozen Plus Import An optional module for importing content from Dzen to WordPress.

Features include:

  • importing articles from a Dzen channel;
  • converting content into Gutenberg blocks;
  • local image storage;
  • support for embedded media;
  • scheduled synchronization.

More information: https://prozen.ru/prozen-plus/

External Services

This plugin relies on external services to fetch public metadata and display content feeds. By using these features, your server will connect to the following third-party platforms:

  • Dzen (https://dzen.ru): The plugin connects to Dzen’s public API to fetch the list of publications for widgets and blocks, and to retrieve article metadata (title, snippet, and cover). Only public channel IDs or article URLs are transmitted.

    • Terms: https://dzen.ru/legal/termsofuse
    • Privacy Policy: https://dzen.ru/legal/confidential

  • VK Video (https://vk.com, https://vkvideo.ru): The VK Video block fetches public video titles and metadata from VK servers using the video URL provided by the user. No personal user data is transmitted.

    • Terms: https://vk.com/terms
    • Privacy Policy: https://vk.com/privacy

  • RuTube (https://rutube.ru): The RuTube block displays an iframe player for public videos. No user data is transmitted from the server.

    • Terms: https://rutube.ru/info/agreement/
    • Privacy Policy: https://rutube.ru/info/privacy/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the prozen folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin via the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Open Settings -> Prozen and configure your Dzen channel URL.
  4. The RSS feed will be available at:
    https://example.com/feed/dzen
sections.faq:
Where can I find my Dzen channel URL?

Open your Dzen channel page. The URL usually looks like:
– https://dzen.ru/yourname
– https://dzen.ru/id/123456789

The RSS feed returns a 404 error

Go to Settings -> Permalinks and click Save Changes to refresh rewrite rules.
